product.olivetti-m30030p.summary: 50 MHz i486DX2 performance variant of the M300-30, using a 25 MHz external bus.
product.olivetti-m30030p.history: The M300-30P is the fast variant of the M300-30: the same board and firmware, but with an i486DX2/50, which runs internally at 50 MHz on a 25 MHz bus.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.verif: BIOS 1.09/Diagnostics 2.00 completes resident diagnostics at 4 MB and reports 640 KB base + 3072 KB extended + 384 KB dedicated = 4096 KB.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.limit: Partial bootable emulation, with the same chipset, video and Super I/O limits as the M300-30. The BIOS works out the CPU model from a board configuration register, reconstructed from the disassembly; it still has to be checked that Diagnostics 2.00 now shows it as DX2-50. Ctrl+Alt+Del can hang while the firmware restarts, so a hard reset is advisable for now. The other RAM configurations and more software remain pending.
product.olivetti-m30030p.technical.manua: Olivetti service guide chapter 36; primary source for M300-30 and M300-30P.
